body:
The comment sat in the middle of a backslash-continued recipe, so the for-loop reached the shell unterminated:

    >> updating Go dependencies
    sh: -c: line 3: syntax error: unexpected end of file from `for' command on line 1
    make: *** [Makefile.common:168: update-go-deps] Error 2

make update-go-deps, update-go-deps-in-dir and update-all-go-deps always failed this way. Move the comment out of the recipe's shell text.

Makefile.common here is the canonical copy synced by scripts/sync_repo_files.sh, so the other repos get the fix on next sync.
